title: 9.1.0 | PTB Patch Notes
body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/9e6e7989055fa210830312b2097ddaa0e48e69bb.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Important[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Due to known technical issues, Michonne will not be playable in the PTB. However, her three unique Perks are available to test. Players will still be able to see her in the Lobby and in the Store, but will not be able to select her to play in a Trial. These issues will be resolved and Michonne will be fully-playable when version 9.1.0 update releases on July 29.[/p][/*][*][p]Progress & save data information has been copied from the Live game to our PTB servers on [b][i]July 1, 2025[/i][/b]. Please note that players will be able to progress for the duration of the PTB, but none of that progress will make it back to the Live version of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Players will once again receive 12,500 Auric Cells on the PTB to explore Outfits and Characters in the Store. Both Auric Cells and purchases made on the PTB Build will not transfer to the Live Build.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]NEW SURVIVOR: Rick Grimes[/b][/h3][p][b]New Perk: Apocalyptic Ingenuity[/b][/p][list][*][p]After unlocking or rummaging through [b]2/2/2 [/b]chests, press the Ability Button 1 for [b]8/8/8 seconds[/b] next to a broken pallet to build a fragile pallet.[/p][/*][*][p]You see the auras of broken pallets within[b] 24/28/32 meters.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fragile pallets are destroyed after being dropped.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Perk: Come and Get Me![/b][/p][list][*][p]After unhooking a Survivor, while crouched and idle, press the Ability Button 1 to make injured and dying Survivors within [b]24/24/24 meters [/b]leave no scratch marks or pools of blood for [b]10/12.5/15 seconds.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]You scream and the Killer sees your aura for [b]5/5/5 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Perk: Teamwork: Toughen Up[/b][/p][list][*][p]When another Survivor pallet-stuns or blinds the Killer while you are injured and within [b]24/24/24 meters[/b], your grunts of pain, scratch marks and pools of blood are reduced by [b]100/100/100%[/b] for[b] 20/25/30 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW SURVIVOR: Michonne Grimes[/b][/h3][p][b]New Perk: Conviction[/b][/p][list][*][p]After you have healed [b]1/1/1 Survivor[/b], while downed with at least [b]25/25/25%[/b] recovery, press Ability Button 2 to recover instantly.[/p][/*][*][p]You gain Broken, then are downed after [b]20/25/30 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Perk: Last Stand[/b][/p][list][*][p]After spending [b]80/70/60 seconds[/b] in the Killer's Terror Radius while not in chase, when you fast-vault, stun the Killer for [b]3/3/3 seconds[/b] if they are within [b]2.5/2.5/2.5 meters[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Then, this perk is disabled for the rest of the trial.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Perk: Teamwork: Throw Down[/b][/p][list][*][p]When you pallet-stun or blind the Killer, other injured Survivors within [b]24/24/24 meters[/b] gain Endurance and see the Killer's aura for [b]6/8/10 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]KILLER UPDATES[/b][/h3][p][b]The Executioner[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Punishment of the Damned's range to [b]10 meters [/b][i](was 8)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased maximum Rites of Judgement duration to [b]10 seconds [/b][i](was 5)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Rites of Judgement trail lifetime to [b]90 seconds [/b][i](was 75)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Rites of Judgement movement speed to [b]4.2m/s[/b] [i](was 4.4)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]The inputs for Rites of Judgement, Punishment of the Damned, and sending a Survivor to a cage can now be held, starting the action as soon as it becomes available.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors who are rescued from a cage now gain [b]10% Haste [/b]and Endurance[b] [/b]for [b]10 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Bloodpoint score for rescuing a Survivor from a cage to [b]2000[/b] [i](was 550)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Executioner's Add-Ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lead Ring [i](Rework)[/i]: Now increases Punishment of the Damned's range by [b]25% [/b]and
